meta.surface: skin-side surface, conformed to the body scan and smoothed
meta.base: complete brace: 22 original openings closed, then conformed to the body
meta.view: seen from the outside of the brace; +y is body up

fit.definition: signed distance skin-side surface -> body scan (+ = gap)

strain.definition: max |principal stretch - 1| per triangle (computed, geometry only)

overlap.definition: triangles whose centroid lies inside another part of the flat pattern
